source: Supplied CCDRMC catalog; implementation status preserved; expert revalidation required

prescriptions.applies_when: "Over Speeding" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Deploy a mobile patrol on the route during the flagged time window.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Alcohol Intake" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Run a checkpoint focused on the identified time window.

prescriptions.applies_when: Weekend-night temporal cluster (Friday–Sunday, 8PM–12MN or similar)
prescriptions.action: Checkpoints and patrol prioritized on weekend nights.

prescriptions.applies_when: Barangay recurring-incident pattern (any cause)
prescriptions.action: Prioritize the barangay for localized patrol scheduling.

prescriptions.applies_when: Tricycle involved in hotspot pattern
prescriptions.action: Check tricycle franchise compliance and roadworthiness at the hotspot.

prescriptions.applies_when: Hotspot barangay + weekend-night cluster identified together
prescriptions.action: Position a speed-gun/radar unit at the specific entry point(s) into the hotspot corridor, not just a general patrol presence.

prescriptions.applies_when: Motorcycle-involved hotspot with no recorded helmet-compliance data
prescriptions.action: Add helmet-use compliance checks to existing checkpoints in motorcycle-dominant barangays.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: The dataset has no helmet-compliance records.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Wrong Overtaking" recorded as cause on a specific stretch
prescriptions.action: Position enforcement specifically at the identified overtaking hotspot during peak travel periods, paired with the LGU Engineering signage request for that stretch.

prescriptions.applies_when: Unregistered/unlicensed tricycle or motorcycle repeatedly cited in a barangay
prescriptions.action: Escalate to a joint checkpoint with LTO/LTFRB for registration and franchise verification.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: The dataset has no citation or violation records.

prescriptions.applies_when: School-zone or market-zone barangay with elevated daytime incident count
prescriptions.action: Post a barangay traffic aide during school arrival/dismissal or market peak hours.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: The dataset does not say which barangays have school or market zones.

prescriptions.applies_when: Private-vehicle-dominant hotspot (car/SUV/pick-up)
prescriptions.action: Include seatbelt and child-restraint compliance checks in routine checkpoints for that area.

prescriptions.applies_when: System-wide, on each dataset refresh
prescriptions.action: Re-issue the patrol schedule whenever the mined rules or hotspot ranking change materially.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: This describes how the system should behave after a refresh, not a condition found in a pattern.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Over Speeding" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Install speed bumps, rumble strips, and speed-limit signage at the hotspot.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Head-on Hit" is the leading collision type
prescriptions.action: Install centerline barriers/markings and "keep right" signage.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Rear-end Hit" is the leading collision type
prescriptions.action: Add advance-warning signage and improve stopping-sight distance.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Slippery Road" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Prioritize road-surface repair and drainage improvement; install wet-road warning signage.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Environmental Factor" recorded as cause / evening-night hotspot
prescriptions.action: Improve street lighting, drainage, and roadside vegetation clearing.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Hit and Run" is the leading collision type
prescriptions.action: Evaluate CCTV/traffic-camera installation at the recurring point.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Side-swipe Hit" is the leading collision type
prescriptions.action: Review lane width and repaint lane markings at the narrow or merging segment identified.

prescriptions.applies_when: Pedestrian involved in a hotspot pattern
prescriptions.action: Install or repaint a pedestrian crossing and improve lighting at the hotspot.

prescriptions.applies_when: Bicycle involved in a hotspot pattern
prescriptions.action: Evaluate bike-lane markings or a shoulder allowance at the hotspot.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Loss of Control" recorded as cause on a curve/embankment section
prescriptions.action: Install guardrails or edge barriers at the identified curve.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: The dataset has no road-geometry information (curves, embankments, intersections).

prescriptions.applies_when: Barangay ranks in the top-N hotspot list for two consecutive dataset refreshes
prescriptions.action: Commission a formal Road Safety Audit (RSA) for that barangay's road network, following DPWH/DOTr RSA methodology.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: This depends on how rankings change across data refreshes, which the system does not track.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Wrong Overtaking" recorded as cause near an intersection or curve
prescriptions.action: Clear roadside vegetation and review sightlines at the identified overtaking hotspot.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: The dataset has no road-geometry information (curves, embankments, intersections).

prescriptions.applies_when: "Animal on Road" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Install animal-crossing warning signage; coordinate fencing with the barangay.

prescriptions.applies_when: Leading recorded cause, town-wide or per barangay
prescriptions.action: Run a road-safety education campaign on that cause.

prescriptions.applies_when: Motorcycle-type vehicles ≥ 50% of local records
prescriptions.action: Focus rider-safety messaging (helmet use, lane position, speed) on motorcycle-type vehicles.
prescriptions.inactive_reason: This depends on the overall share of motorcycle records, not on any single pattern.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Alcohol Intake" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Run an anti-drunk-driving awareness campaign in barangays with recurring alcohol-linked incidents.

prescriptions.applies_when: "Mechanical Failure" recorded as cause
prescriptions.action: Include pre-trip inspection reminders (brakes, tires, lights) in driver-facing IEC materials.

prescriptions.applies_when: Weekend/Sunday temporal cluster
prescriptions.action: Circulate family/leisure-travel safety reminders ahead of the weekend.

prescriptions.applies_when: Pedestrian involved in a hotspot pattern
prescriptions.action: Run pedestrian safety awareness messaging (crossing points, visibility at night) for that area.

prescriptions.applies_when: Hotspot barangay identified in the top-N ranking
prescriptions.action: Deploy localized tarpaulins/signage at the corridor itself ("Accident-Prone Area — Slow Down") rather than only general campaign materials.

prescriptions.applies_when: Hotspot barangay identified in the top-N ranking
prescriptions.action: Post social media / SMS advisories when conditions matching the hotspot's cause.

prescriptions.applies_when: Tricycle/PUV-dominant barangay
prescriptions.action: Run defensive-driving seminars for tricycle/PUV drivers via barangay assemblies, coordinated with the local operators' association.
